global_rules: do not use name as identity
do not expose System User token to browser
browser does not write operational plan
raw ids not in public docs

rejected_options.A_add_meta_to_legacy_campaigns: Rejected: legacy campaigns/daily_campaign_metrics and settings UI are Google/GAM-coupled and browser/action unsafe.
rejected_options.B_parallel_campaigns_meta_only: Rejected alone: would duplicate provider-neutral identity, receipts, freshness and events already designed in trafego_*.

tables.currency: store account currency; money as minor units
tables.deletion_archival: remote delete/archive becomes presence/status, not row DELETE
tables.external_identity: store raw external id only in private DB fields; public docs use redacted examples
tables.grants: service_role/backend-only writes; authenticated reads only through safe views/RPCs when later approved
tables.idempotency: unique provider/account/external id or VOLC blueprint hash
tables.purpose: Provider-neutral campaign identity reused for Meta campaign instances
tables.raw_payload_policy: allowed only in private DB JSONB with redaction guard; prohibited in public docs
tables.retention: append receipts/events; raw sync payload retention bounded by policy
tables.rls: ENABLE + FORCE RLS; zero browser write policies
tables.shared_objects: creative/assets may be shared across campaigns via binding tables
tables.timezone: store account timezone and UTC read timestamp
